items.title: Branford Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I know Lulu. And Richard Strauss.

ctx.x: Sounds like you listen to opera. Do you listen to any of the 20th-century German composers of opera, like Alban Berg,? Do you know his music?

Yeah. I know Lulu. And Richard Strauss. [You know…] Like Lulu, yeah. I’m not really a fan of all of the, the, the, …you know, what do they call it, I guess, “avant-garde,“ for lack of a better term? But I do like, I like the ones…. (coughs) I like anything if it has melody in it. And the idea that avant-garde should have an absence of melody is absurd. [And, you know…] The avant-garde sound allowed a lot of mediocre composers to jump into the fray who otherwise would’ve been able to do anything. That’s not Berg,…
